paragraphs: Rav Mari bar Avuha reported in the name of R' Yitzchak; Pesachim 83a and Chullin 125a.[^1]

notes.text: א״ר יצחק gives the terse formula “R' Yitzchak said,” read here as Mari reporting in Yitzchak’s name. Hyman gives no statement content. פג. and קכה.. give 83a and 125a under the period convention, with the second doubled stop preserved in Hebrew; no named edition is independently checked. Mari’s full Rav is preserved.
